contribution.position: My position stands: reliability evidence is mixed. The test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and perf report (p99 within budget at peak load) are positive, but the incident log records two sev2 retry-storm incidents last quarter — the exact failure mode this change touches. Neither report demonstrates the change has been exercised under retry-storm conditions, so confidence in reliability requires that targeted evidence before the current green signals can be taken as covering this risk.
